title: Geller 2019 radio interview: Puharich drugged him with mushrooms and hypnosis

tellings.quote: on a radio show in like 2019 saying that Puharich had experimented on him with with mushrooms

plain: According to a researcher named Greg Malatzi, the self-described psychic Uri Geller said on a radio show around 2019 that a researcher named Puharich, who worked with him in the 1970s, had experimented on him with mushrooms and hypnosis. Malatzi passes this on second-hand. It would mean that some of Geller's famous early experiences were shaped by drugs and hypnosis.
